title: 让步反驳式开头：先承认再转折
scene: 议论段开头，对方的说法有一定道理，但由它推不出结论时先让一步再反驳
pattern: While it is true that [ ], it does not necessarily follow that [ ].
example: While it is true that smartphones keep students connected with the outside world, it does not necessarily follow that they belong in the classroom.
example_zh: 智能手机确实让学生与外界保持联系，但这并不意味着它们就该出现在课堂上。
note: it does not necessarily follow that 后面必须接完整从句，that 不能省略；转折已由主句承担，从句里不要再加 but 或 however。

title: 揭示实质：不在表面而在深层
scene: 分析现象成因时，把议论从表面现象推进到深层原因
pattern: What makes [ ] so [ ] is not [ ] but [ ].
example: What makes the decline in teenagers' reading time so alarming is not the number of books they skip but the habit of reading in fragments that they carry into adult life.
example_zh: 青少年阅读时间的下降之所以令人警觉，不在于他们少读了几本书，而在于他们把碎片化阅读的习惯带进了成年生活。
note: not A but B 两侧成分必须平行（同为名词短语或同为从句）；what 引导的主语从句视为单数，谓语用 is，不要用 are。

title: 递进影响：不仅而且的倒装
scene: 阐述某个现象的连锁后果，需要把两层影响一次说清
pattern: Not only does [ ], it also [ ].
example: Not only does prolonged screen time strain students' eyesight, it also erodes their patience for tasks that demand sustained attention.
example_zh: 长时间看屏幕不仅损害学生视力，也消磨他们对需要持续专注的任务的耐心。
note: Not only 置于句首时主句必须部分倒装（助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形），动词不能再加 -s 或 -ed；后半句用正常语序，且不要再用 but。

title: 虚拟倒装句式：假如发生会怎样
scene: 假设论证，设想某项措施取消或某种做法延续下去的后果
pattern: Were [ ] to [ ], [ ] would [ ].
example: Were universities to cancel all written examinations, students would have little incentive to consolidate what they learn term by term.
example_zh: 假如大学取消所有笔试，学生就几乎没有动力逐学期巩固所学。
note: 这是省略 if 后的倒装，只能用于虚拟语气（were / should / had 提前）；主句必须配 would / could / might + 动词原形，用 will 就错了。

title: 数据引用句式：让论据落地
scene: 开头段或论证段用调查、统计引出话题，避免通篇空谈
pattern: A recent survey of [ ] found that [ ], a proportion that [ ].
example: A recent survey of 3,000 college students found that nearly two-thirds of them read fewer than one book a month, a proportion that has risen steadily since 2015.
example_zh: 一项针对三千名大学生的近期调查发现，其中近三分之二的人每月读书不足一本，这一比例自2015年以来持续上升。
note: 逗号后的 a proportion that 是同位语补充说明前面的数字，不是新句子，不能用 which 指代整个从句；分数后要接 of + 代词或名词（two-thirds of them）。

title: 概念澄清：先界定概念再展开
scene: 讨论抽象话题（真正的教育、成功、自由）时先给定义，防止后文跑题
pattern: By [ ] I do not mean [ ] so much as [ ].
example: By a good education I do not mean a long list of courses so much as the ability to judge what is worth learning.
example_zh: 我说的良好教育，与其说是一长串课程，不如说是判断什么值得学的能力。
note: not A so much as B 意为「与其说 A 不如说 B」，重心落在 B；A、B 需结构对称，且不能与 not only ... but also 混用。

title: 价值判断：价值究竟在哪里
scene: 结尾段评价某事物的意义，替代 is very important 这类空话
pattern: The value of [ ] lies less in [ ] than in [ ].
example: The value of volunteer teaching lies less in the knowledge volunteers pass on than in the confidence they help children build.
example_zh: 支教的价值，与其说在于志愿者传授的知识，不如说在于他们帮孩子建立起的自信。
note: less ... than 比较的是两个介词短语，前后须同构（in A 对 in B）；主语是单数时谓语用 lies / consists / rests，别漏掉 -s。

title: 提建议句式：早就该做的事
scene: 建议段给出具体改进方向，语气比 should 更明确，又不失分寸
pattern: It is high time that [ ] [past-tense verb], and [ ] would do well to [ ].
example: It is high time that universities reduced the number of optional courses, and students would do well to plan their terms around depth rather than breadth.
example_zh: 大学早该减少选修课的数量，而学生也不妨按深度而非广度来规划自己的学期。
note: It is high time that 后的从句用一般过去时（虚拟），写成 reduce 就是错的；would do well to 后接动词原形，是委婉建议，不再是虚拟语气。

title: 对比论证：两相对照见差异
scene: 论证段比较两种做法或两代人的差异，用对照把观点凸显出来
pattern: Compared with [ ], [ ] tend to [ ], which explains why [ ].
example: Compared with students who take notes by hand, those who type everything tend to capture more words but fewer ideas, which explains why the pen still matters.
example_zh: 与手写笔记的学生相比，全程打字的学生往往记下更多字词却更少观点，这也解释了为什么笔仍然重要。
note: compared with / to 是状语，其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致；those who 指复数，谓语用 tend 而不是 tends；which 引导非限制性定语从句，前面要有逗号。

title: 结论收束段：真问题在哪里
scene: 结尾段收束全文，把讨论引向真正值得争论的问题，而不是简单站队
pattern: The question, then, is not whether [ ] but how [ ].
example: The question, then, is not whether technology belongs in the classroom but to what extent it should replace the teacher's judgment.
example_zh: 那么，问题不在于技术该不该进入课堂，而在于它应在多大程度上取代教师的判断。
note: not whether ... but how / to what extent 是名词性从句并列，两边都要有完整的主谓结构；question 作主语时谓语用 is。

title: 时间起点：since 与 for 之别
scene: 翻译「自唐代以来」「近二十年来」这类时间状语
pattern: [ ] has [past participle] since [ ], a custom that has [ ].
example: Tea drinking has been part of Chinese daily life since the Tang Dynasty, a custom that has spread to almost every corner of the world.
example_zh: 自唐代以来，饮茶就是中国人日常生活的一部分，这一习俗已传播到世界几乎所有角落。
note: since 后接时间点（the Tang Dynasty、2010），不能接时间段；时间段用 for twenty years。现在完成时 has been 不能改成 is；a custom that 是同位语，不是并列句。

title: 被誉为：三种译法的细微差别
scene: 翻译「被誉为……之乡」「被称为……的代表」这类评价性说法
pattern: [ ] is widely [ ] as [ ], with [ ] drawing [ ].
example: Suzhou is widely regarded as the Venice of the East, with its canals and classical gardens drawing visitors from around the world.
example_zh: 苏州被誉为「东方威尼斯」，其运河与古典园林吸引着世界各地的游客。
note: be regarded as / be hailed as 后接名词，不能接形容词；「被誉为……的摇篮」译作 be known as the cradle of，不要生造 be praised as；with 复合结构表伴随，动词用 -ing 形式。

title: 随着…发展：避免空泛开篇
scene: 翻译段首的「随着……的发展／普及」，需要补出具体的变化对象
pattern: As [ ] has [past participle], [ ] has [past participle] as well.
example: As high-speed rail has extended into smaller cities, weekend travel has become a routine part of family life.
example_zh: 随着高铁向中小城市延伸，周末出游已成为家庭生活的日常内容。
note: 不要机械套 with the development of society，要写出具体的发展对象和结果；as 从句与主句时态要呼应，多用现在完成时表示持续影响。

title: 发挥作用：与 role 搭配的动词
scene: 翻译「在……中发挥着重要作用／起着决定性作用」
pattern: [ ] plays a [ ] role in [ ], without which [ ].
example: Parental example plays a decisive role in forming a child's reading habit, without which homework alone can hardly turn a pupil into a reader.
example_zh: 父母的示范在培养孩子阅读习惯方面起着决定性作用，缺少这一习惯，单靠作业很难让一个小学生爱上阅读。
note: role 前用 play a ... role，不能用 make 或 take；without which 引导非限制性定语从句，其先行词必须明确（此处是 habit），不能含糊地指代整个句子。

title: 越来越多：量词与谓语的配合
scene: 翻译「越来越多的人／家庭／企业……」这类趋势句
pattern: A growing number of [ ] [plural verb], a shift that [ ].
example: A growing number of young couples are choosing to live near their parents, a shift that is reshaping the housing market in many cities.
example_zh: 越来越多的年轻夫妇选择住在父母附近，这一变化正在重塑许多城市的住房市场。
note: a growing number of 后接可数名词复数，谓语用复数（are 而非 is）；不可数名词改用 a growing amount of；a shift that 作同位语，不能写成 and this shift which。

title: 起源于：date back 的用法
scene: 翻译「起源于……」「已有……年历史」这类文化介绍句
pattern: [ ] dates back to [ ] and originated in [ ].
example: The Dragon Boat Festival dates back more than two thousand years and originated in the custom of honoring a patriotic poet.
example_zh: 端午节可追溯到两千多年前，起源于纪念一位爱国诗人的习俗。
note: date back to 用主动语态、一般现在时，不加被动，也不加 -s 到 back 上；originate in 后接地点或时期，originate from 后接来源；「有……年历史」也可译 be ... years old。

title: 奠定基础：与 lay 搭配的名词
scene: 翻译「为……奠定基础／打下根基」以及由此引出的因果链
pattern: [ ] laid the foundation for [ ], which in turn [ ].
example: The popularization of compulsory education laid the foundation for China's economic takeoff, which in turn created millions of skilled jobs.
example_zh: 义务教育的普及为中国经济的腾飞奠定了基础，而经济腾飞又创造了数以百万计的技术岗位。
note: 固定搭配是 lay the foundation for，不用 build 或 make the foundation；lay 的过去式和过去分词都是 laid，不是 layed；which in turn 承接因果链，注意前后时态一致。

title: 占重要地位：position 用法
scene: 翻译「在国民经济中占有重要地位／居于核心位置」这类说明句
pattern: [ ] occupies a [ ] position in [ ], and this is reflected in [ ].
example: Agriculture occupies a central position in the national economy, and this is reflected in the fact that nearly one in four workers earns a living from the land.
example_zh: 农业在国民经济中占有中心地位，这一点体现在近四分之一的劳动者以土地为生。
note: occupy 后接 a ... position，不能用 the ... place；「占首位」译 rank first / top the list，不说 occupy the first；this is reflected in 后接名词或 the fact that 从句，不能直接跟句子。

title: 应试与素质：一对高频对比词
scene: 讨论教育改革、评价方式、课程设置时描述两种教育取向
pattern: exam-oriented education / well-rounded education / education for all-round development
example: The shift from exam-oriented education to a well-rounded one requires not only new tests but also teachers trained to assess qualities that no test can capture.
example_zh: 从应试教育转向素质教育，不仅需要新的考试，还需要能评价考试无法衡量的品质的教师。
note: exam-oriented 作定语要用连字符；「素质教育」官方译法常见 education for all-round development，quality-oriented education 属直译，考场上求稳可用前者。

title: 入学率与辍学率的表达方式
scene: 描述教育普及程度、城乡教育差距的数据类句子
pattern: enrollment rate / dropout rate / access to education
example: Rural enrollment rates have risen sharply, yet the dropout rate in senior high school remains high enough to keep thousands of teenagers out of university.
example_zh: 农村入学率大幅上升，但高中辍学率仍然偏高，使数千名青少年无缘大学。
note: 「入学率」是 enrollment rate（英式拼作 enrolment）；dropout 作名词连写，作动词短语写 drop out；access to education 后接名词，不接动词原形。

title: 技术替代：机器换人与岗位流失
scene: 讨论人工智能、自动化对就业结构和技能要求的冲击
pattern: automate routine tasks / displace workers / job displacement
example: Automation has displaced thousands of assembly-line workers, and the challenge is to retrain them before the next wave of technology arrives.
example_zh: 自动化已使数千名流水线工人失去岗位，难题在于赶在下一波技术到来之前对他们进行再培训。
note: 机器取代动作用 replace 或 automate，人失去岗位用 displace / be made redundant；displace 是及物动词，不能说 workers displace；retrain 表示「再培训」，前缀 re- 不能漏。

title: 数字鸿沟、数据隐私的搭配
scene: 讨论数字技术普及带来的公平问题与个人信息安全问题
pattern: the digital divide / data privacy / the leakage of personal information
example: The digital divide is no longer only about owning a smartphone; it is about having the skills to use one safely.
example_zh: 数字鸿沟不再只是有没有智能手机的问题，而是有没有安全使用它的技能的问题。
note: digital divide 前用定冠词 the；「信息泄露」常用 data breach 或 the leakage of personal information，不用 information leak out；privacy 不可数，不加 -s。

title: 文化遗产与传承的固定说法
scene: 讨论传统文化保护、非物质文化遗产传承的段落
pattern: intangible cultural heritage / pass down from generation to generation / keep ... alive
example: Intangible cultural heritage survives only when it is passed down from generation to generation and adapted to the tastes of each new one.
example_zh: 非物质文化遗产只有在代代相传并适应每一代人的审美之后才能存活。
note: 「传承」用 pass down 或 carry forward，「继承」用 inherit（多指财产或特征）；heritage 不可数，不能说 heritages；from generation to generation 中间不加冠词。

title: 碳排放与可持续发展的搭配
scene: 讨论环保政策、绿色生活、气候目标的句子
pattern: carbon emissions / cut emissions / sustainable development
example: Cutting carbon emissions in cities means persuading commuters to leave their cars at home, not merely building more charging stations.
example_zh: 减少城市碳排放意味着说服通勤者把车留在家里，而不只是多建一些充电桩。
note: emission 指排放物时常用复数 emissions；「减排」是 cut / reduce emissions，不要写 lower down emissions；sustainable 是「可持续的」，sustained 是「持续的」，别混用。

title: 人口老龄化：aging 的用法
scene: 讨论养老负担、劳动力结构、社会保障压力的段落
pattern: an aging population / the growing elderly population / a shrinking workforce
example: An aging population puts pressure on pension funds, and the pressure is felt most sharply in provinces where the young have moved away.
example_zh: 人口老龄化给养老基金带来压力，这种压力在年轻人外流的省份感受最为明显。
note: aging 修饰 population 时是形容词，不作动名词；the elderly 作集合名词，谓语用复数；pension funds 用复数表示泛指。

title: 城乡差距、人口流动的表达
scene: 讨论城乡发展不平衡、农民工进城、资源分配不均
pattern: the urban-rural gap / rural-to-urban migration / migrant workers
example: The urban-rural gap in medical resources is one reason rural-to-urban migration continues even as small towns offer more jobs.
example_zh: 医疗资源的城乡差距，是小镇提供更多岗位却仍有大量人口进城的原因之一。
note: migration 指人口迁移，immigration 专指移居他国；urban-rural 的连字符不能省，否则会读成两个并列名词；migrant workers 作群体泛指时用复数更自然。

title: 社会责任感、公益参与的说法
scene: 讨论青年担当、志愿服务、公民意识的结尾段
pattern: a sense of social responsibility / public participation / contribute to the community
example: Volunteering gives students a sense of social responsibility that no lecture on civic duty can supply.
example_zh: 志愿服务带给学生的社会责任感，是任何公民课都讲不出来的。
note: 「责任感」用 a sense of responsibility，responsibility 在此不可数；participate 是 participate in，participation 后也跟 in；contribute to 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

title: 消费升级、过度消费的表达
scene: 讨论年轻人消费行为、直播带货、理性消费与储蓄率
pattern: consumption upgrading / impulse buying / spend beyond one's means
example: Impulse buying is easy to blame on live-streaming hosts, but spending beyond one's means usually starts with a budget nobody wrote down.
example_zh: 冲动消费很容易归咎于直播主播，但入不敷出往往始于一份没人写下来的预算。
note: means 表示「财力」时恒为复数，beyond one's means 不写 mean；consumption 不可数，不加 -s；blame A on B 用介词 on，不用 for 或 to。

title: 就业压力、灵活就业的搭配
scene: 讨论毕业生就业难、零工经济、职业稳定性
pattern: employment pressure / the gig economy / flexible employment
example: The gig economy offers graduates flexible income, but it also leaves them without the training that a steady job once provided.
example_zh: 零工经济给毕业生带来灵活收入，却也让他们失去稳定工作曾经提供的培训。
note: employment 不可数，不用 employments；gig economy 前用定冠词 the；flexible employment 指用工形式灵活，与 flexible working hours（弹性工时）不是一回事。

title: 产业转型与区域协调发展的表述
scene: 讨论老工业城市转型、新兴产业布局、区域发展政策
pattern: industrial upgrading / the shift to high-value industries / coordinated regional development
example: Industrial upgrading has given the old steel city cleaner air, but it has also left thousands of workers searching for skills they never needed before.
example_zh: 产业升级让这座老钢铁城市的空气更清洁，却也让数千名工人去寻找他们从前并不需要的技能。
note: upgrade 作名词时多用 industrial upgrading；「转型」在书面语里常用 restructuring 或 transition to，shift to 偏口语；coordinated regional development 前不加 the，表示政策概念。
